name: Green Bay (experience-v2 template)
firstTouchBody:
Hi {{business_name}} team,

We're launching CheckOff in {{metro}}. It's a free app that helps people discover and check off great local experiences, and we selected {{business_name}} as one of the places worth discovering.

CheckOff features specific local experiences rather than creating a conventional business listing. The CheckOff experience we selected for {{business_name}} is:

{{experiences_block}}

To find it in the app, download CheckOff free at {{download_url}}, open it, and choose {{metro}}: your experience appears there. The public page above also opens it directly on your phone, no sign-in needed.

There is no fee to be included and nothing to sign up for. We feature exceptional businesses for free because a great CheckOff app needs great places.

Two quick things would help:
- Use your private link above to confirm the experience is still accurate, or tell us what to change.
- If you have a photo you'd prefer us to use, add it there or just reply and attach it.

We also made a free set of print, social, Story, and in-business graphics you can use: {{kit_url}}

You can reply to this email any time.

Thanks for being part of it!

Jerry Stuckart
Founder, CheckOff
getcheckoff.com
followUp1Body:
